about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/redacted: edits of the leaf's source that its own tests must kill. Its rows moved from runtime/v1's ledger when BS8 moved the code into this leaf (re-anchored by wf10 EXPLORE-rt r3). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/redacted (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger").

mutants.name: s-config-redacted-inline
mutants.rule: A secret's payload sits behind a pointer field, so Go's fmt can only print its address.
